verdict.rationale: LM Studio runs models locally and documents that RAG works entirely offline and that Bionic voice data never leaves the device. Data kept on-device cannot be collected for training, but this is implied by local execution rather than stated as a no-training guarantee. missing for 10: an explicit first-party policy that user data is never used for training, a stated guarantee covering all chat/prompt data and telemetry, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline
Download and run local LLMs like gpt-oss or Llama, Qwen
